sections.title: Cantonal income tax tariff (Vaud, Barème 2026)

source.title: AFC/ESTV Feuille cantonale Vaud (Etat: février 2026), impôt sur le revenu: calcul de l'impôt, art. 47 LI

sections.basis: Taxable income, per year (simple tax, before the multipliers)
sections.note: Tariff vintage: Barème 2026, per ESTV Kantonsblatt (Stand Februar 2026).

rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: Family quotient (art. 43 LI): the rate is set on the taxable income divided by the household's parts — 1 for a single person, 1.8 for a married couple, 1.3 for a single parent, plus 0.5 per child (the child reduction is capped)

rows.label: Reduction of the cantonal base income tax for 2026 (art. 4 LRIPP)
rows.value: 5% (4% in 2025), except tax on liquidation profits and capital benefits (art. 48a and 49 LI)

source.title: AFC/ESTV Feuille cantonale Vaud (Etat: février 2026), impôt sur le revenu: calcul de l'impôt, art. 47 LI

source.title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

sections.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Lausanne; other communes in Vaud set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
